# Agentic Workspaces

> One folder of plain-text files per project, a tiny pointer skill per AI
> assistant (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI), a private git backup.
> Conventions, templates, and a small dependency-free Python script. The
> durable asset in agentic work is not the agent, it's the record.

## Docs

Paths are relative to the repository root.

- [README](README.md): what this is, 10-minute quickstart, file roles, lifecycle, pointer-skill setup, what it doesn't do
- [Workspace conventions](skills/new-ai-workspace/references/workspace-conventions.md): the file set, update discipline, layout, discovery per tool
- [System skill](skills/new-ai-workspace/SKILL.md): how agents operate the system
- [Example](examples/): a filled-in fictional workspace and its pointer skill
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Key ideas

- Files over conversations: any session can end without losing state
- Provider-neutral: every assistant reads the same files; the skill is a pointer
- Status = where things stand; decisions = what was decided and why, dated; next actions = what needs doing
- Four certainty levels: confirmed / decided / tentative / unreviewed idea
- One home per fact; staged (inbox) is not accepted; archive, don't delete
